text:
arjun (sales): Heads-up — Swan Labs escalation. Renewal in ~6w. They want a regional hosted SLA: 99.9% uptime and 95th latency <150ms in eu-west-1. If we can't commit they may cancel ($420k ARR).

maya (product): Oof. Do we have perf numbers for eu-west on their traffic profile? @eli

eli (eng): Not at that SLA today. With current batching + prefix cache we see ~200–300ms 95th on their sample seq lengths at peak qps. Dedicated reserved pool would meet it but hosted path needs routing and stronger isolation.

sam (solutions): Swan explicitly said they can't take Dedicated right now (security policy). They want hosted with guarantees or credits. They said fallback to a smaller model is acceptable only if quality drop <8% on their eval.

jackie (swan-labs): Confirming — we can tolerate minor quality loss but need numbers. We'll share eval set and a 72h p95 trace.

rhea (pm): This is classic customer-driven ask vs roadmap. We need a quick prioritization approach. RICE quick take?

maya (product): Quick RICE draft: Reach=1 (single account), Impact=9 (high churn risk), Confidence=40%, Effort~=3 (sprints) -> Score=(1*9*0.4)/3 = 1.2

eli (eng): Effort estimate is optimistic. infra + SRE runbooks + billing + routing = probably 6–8w. Also we need SLIs, monitoring, and auto-fallback logic.

maya (product): Noted. Options on table:
- A) 30-day hosted SLA pilot + credit cap (canary + prepay).
- B) Full hosted SLA with reserved capacity (longer lead time).
- C) Push back, offer discount and technical plan for Dedicated later.

arjun (sales): Customer will push for A or B. They won't accept C as final. If we do A, we should ask for partial prepay or a letter of intent.

sam (solutions): Can we run a perf spike this week against their sample workload? If we can demo 95th <150ms in eu-west with tuned batching/caching that buys time.

eli (eng): I can run a spike Tue. Need their eval dataset + QPS profile and sequence-length histogram. Otherwise it's noisy.

jackie (swan-labs): Sending dataset now (SFTP link). We'll include a 72h trace. We're open to the 30-day pilot with credits.

maya (product): Small RICE snip for record:
```
Reach = 1
Impact = 9
Confidence = 0.4
Effort = 3
Score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort = 1.2
```
This is just a starting point — adjust if effort goes to 6.

eli (eng): If spike looks good we still need: SLA enforcement code (credit calc), per-customer routing policy, and test harness. I estimate 2 engineers + 1 SRE for 4w post-spike to get pilot-ready.

paul (legal): I can draft a 30-day SLA addendum with credit cap and rollback language. Need exact metric definitions (p95 vs p95 latency window), scope (only eu-west), and termination triggers.

maya (product): Action plan: 1) Eli runs perf spike (Tue). 2) Arjun to secure partial prepay / LOI. 3) Paul to draft addendum. 4) Jackie to confirm dataset and success criteria. We'll reconvene after spike.

arjun (sales): I'll ask for 30% prepay and LOI. Also flagging renewal team to prioritize.

jackie (swan-labs): We'll prepare evaluation criteria: quality drop <=8% on our eval metric, and p95 <150ms for 72h.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary test slot available Wed 02:00–04:00 UTC (eu-west-1). Please tag @eli to claim.

eli (eng): Claiming Wed 02:00. I'll run configured replay and share results here.

rhea (pm): If spike passes, propose converting to Dedicated within 3 months and include a migration credit in the SLA to address their security worry. That balances immediate churn risk vs roadmap impact.

maya (product): Sounds like the consensus. We'll treat as a high-risk-high-impact spike. If spike fails, fallback is discount + roadmap commitment with clear timeline.

sam (solutions): Recording: customer ask = hosted regional latency SLA; constraints = no Dedicated now; success = 72h p95 <150ms + <=8% quality drop; commercial = 30% prepay + 30-day pilot credits.

arjun (sales): Thanks all. I'll loop legal + customer. Replan after spike. :thumbsup:

paul (legal): I'll start draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

maya (product): Great. Close loop after Eli's run.

jackie (swan-labs): Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll standby for the results.
